mechanism: Place an impeccably controlled subject inside a rigid public ritual, introduce one initially manageable physical liability, escalate its collateral effects in countable steps, then expose a visible failure while the subject preserves exactly the same confident performance rule. The mismatch between increasing chaos and unchanged poise creates the payoff; casting, setting, hazard, costume, palette and final consequence are variable.

invariants.rule: Establish a formal ritual with a clear success posture before disruption begins.
invariants.purpose: Gives the audience a behavioral baseline.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without a stable ritual, later chaos reads as ordinary disorder.

invariants.rule: Introduce one physical liability attached to the subject and keep its cause visible.
invariants.ablation_failure: Random background accidents break the comedy engine.

invariants.rule: Escalate collateral consequences at least twice while the subject maintains the same poise.
invariants.ablation_failure: Changing attitude too early releases tension before the payoff.

invariants.rule: Show one irreversible visible failure only after collateral has peaked.
invariants.purpose: Converts disruption into a clean state change.
invariants.ablation_failure: An early failure removes the escalation ladder.

invariants.rule: End on confident continuation rather than explanation or embarrassment.
invariants.purpose: Turns failure into a controlled mic-drop.
invariants.ablation_failure: Apology or panic replaces deadpan comedy with ordinary mishap.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original subject whose identity and silhouette remain stable.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific location.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One readable variable that changes monotonically or in countable stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: One restrained performance rule that makes the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: A coherent information order that does not copy the source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: One clean physical or graphic consequence that closes the causal chain.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: A new hierarchy of diegetic cues supporting each state change.

instantiations.concept: A poised pastry chef presents a towering kinetic sugar sculpture on a live studio turntable; each elegant adjustment triggers a larger set failure, the outer sugar sail snaps, and she completes the bow without breaking her smile.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Deadpan culinary prestige: formal demo, attached sugar liability, two collateral escalations, visible break and immaculate final bow.

instantiations.concept: A ceremonial museum guide unveils a wind-driven paper installation whose ribbons progressively topple display stanchions; one panel detaches, yet the guide completes the scripted gesture with perfect calm.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Museum ritual versus attached paper chaos, ending on unbroken curatorial poise.

instantiations.concept: An orchestra conductor leads a miniature automaton ensemble as one overlong cable tangles stands, pulls a curtain and unplugs the finale; the conductor finishes the cadence as if planned.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Performance formality, one cable liability, escalating collateral and a composed cadence after failure.

failure_modes.failure: Several unrelated accidents happen at once.
failure_modes.repair: Use one attached liability and show how each consequence follows from it.

failure_modes.failure: The subject reacts with panic before the visible failure.
failure_modes.repair: Lock one confident expression and posture until the final hold.

failure_modes.failure: The new version simply changes the runway animal.
failure_modes.repair: Change ritual, setting, hazard physics, camera grammar, costume and payoff together.
